fusions.name: Mountain's Weight
fusions.desc: You rear up and drop your full weight onto the ground, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Wounded Bulk
fusions.desc: A swipe of your full, rock-weighted bulk that deals 13 damage, knocks the target 3 tiles back and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It deals 6% more for every tenth of your health already lost, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Denning Down
fusions.desc: You hunker down into the ground, regaining 4 health a second for 8 seconds, and you carry 10% physical resistance.

fusions.name: Hill-Shouldered
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14, and you carry 6% physical resistance.
